summary: Phase 7 (neck ultrasound follow-up, medical documents, physician notes) tested end-to-end on the Java backend and React UI. Backend: 15/15 new pytest tests pass, and the phase 5+6 regression suites pass 23/23. Covered: ultrasound CRUD and validation (missing exam_date 422, future date 400, bad enum 422, dimension >500 422, foreign or unknown report_document_id 404). Documents: PNG/PDF upload, real object-storage round-trip with exact bytes, signature sniffing (text renamed to .png gives 400), bad category or future date 400, >10MB 413, soft delete then 404. Physician: list and download work, patient role gets 403, unassigned patient 404. Notes: create (ultrasound/document/general), target validation 404/400/422, only the author can edit or delete (patient 403, admin 403/404), patient sees edits. UI: patient sidebar ultrasound/documents nav works. The ultrasound dialog's save button stays disabled until a Jalali date is picked. All selects work, the 'other' reason shows a text field, report upload and findings add/remove work. The saved card shows every value plus the findings table and a report chip that opens a blob tab. Edit pre-fills all fields, including Persian digits, and persists; non-numeric dims show a client toast; 600mm shows a generic 422 toast. Delete works with a confirm step. Documents page: client rejects .txt, server rejects a fake .png (toast shown), PDF upload with category/title/date/notes works, open/filter/delete work. Physician detail /physician/patients/<id>: physician-records shows the patient's ultrasounds and documents, has no patient edit or delete buttons, and files open. Notes add on ultrasound, document and general; edit and delete work. The patient sees ultrasound and document notes read-only with no inputs. At 390px there is no page overflow on /patient/ultrasound, /patient/documents or the dialogs, and bottom-nav scrolls horizontally (scrollWidth 524 > 390, overflow-x auto). ONE FUNCTIONAL BUG: general physician notes are never shown to the patient.

minor.issue: Physician notes attached to a deleted ultrasound or soft-deleted document are not removed or hidden. GET /api/patient/notes and /api/physician/patients/{id}/notes keep returning these orphan notes (verified). They are invisible in the UI but still listed in the API and stay in the DB.

On 422, the specific Persian message (e.g. 'اندازه باید بین ۰ تا ۵۰۰ میلی‌متر باشد') is not shown in the UI; the toast is the generic 'برخی از مقادیر واردشده معتبر نیستند'. Either surface field errors or add a client-side 0-500 check.

ui_bugs.issue: General physician notes (target_type='general'), created via note-input-general on the physician page, are NOT rendered anywhere for the patient. NotesThread with targetType='general' is used only in PhysicianRecords.jsx (canWrite). NeckUltrasound.jsx and Documents.jsx fetch /patient/notes but render only per-ultrasound and per-document threads, and the dashboard does not show them either. This breaks the requirement that notes are visible to the patient.

integration_issues.issue: The report file is uploaded before the ultrasound is saved. If the save then fails (e.g. a 422 on size >500), the uploaded document stays as an orphan, and every retry uploads a duplicate 'گزارش سونوگرافی گردن' document. Fix: keep the uploaded id in state after the first upload, or validate before uploading.

issues: note-delete-<id> deletes immediately without the ConfirmDelete dialog used elsewhere (minor UX inconsistency).

action_items: HIGH: Render general physician notes for the patient (e.g. a 'یادداشت‌های پزشک' block on /patient/documents or the dashboard using NotesThread targetType='general' canWrite={false}).
Delete or hide physician notes whose ultrasound/document target was deleted (filter in PhysicianNoteService.forPatient, or delete them in the ultrasound and document delete paths).
UltrasoundDialog: avoid duplicate or orphan report uploads when the save fails (cache the uploaded reportId in state).
Optional: surface the backend's field-level validation messages on 422, or add client-side 0-500mm checks.
critical_code_review_comments: PhysicianNoteService.create: when target_type is 'document' it checks that the document isn't deleted, but ultrasound targets are hard-deleted, so notes on them are orphaned. There is no cascade because target_id is not a foreign key.

DocumentService upload: size check plus magic-byte sniffing is good. The content type stored is the sniffed one, not the client-supplied one (correct). Downloads set nosniff, inline and no-store (good).
UltrasoundDialog.submit: uploadDocument runs before toBody validation, so a client-side 'ابعاد باید عدد باشند' error happens after the file is already uploaded (orphan upload).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all flows work; general notes not visible to patient)

seed_data_creation: None left behind. All TEST data I created (ultrasounds, documents including the ultrasound report upload, notes, TEST_P7 user) was deleted. E1's own TEST_doc (d7989565...) and ultrasound 2026-10-01 (501bba36...) were left untouched.

rca of the issue: General notes: PhysicianRecords renders NotesThread targetType='general', but no patient page renders it. NeckUltrasound.jsx and Documents.jsx pass notes only to UltrasoundCard and DocumentList, which filter by target_type 'ultrasound' or 'document' with a matching target_id. Repro: as the physician, add a note in note-input-general; as the patient, check /patient, /patient/ultrasound and /patient/documents. The note is absent, although GET /api/patient/notes returns it.
